Questions

Your Pricing Questions Answered:

Can I try AIclicks before committing?

Yes. Starter and Pro plans include a 3-day free trial. No credit card required to start. Business plan includes a live demo with the team.

Can I track multiple brands or sub-brands?

Yes. You can create separate projects for each brand or sub-brand. Each project has its own prompt set, visibility score, and competitor tracking. Prompts can be split across projects however you need.

Can I change plans or cancel anytime?

Yes. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel at any time from your account settings. No lock-in contracts on monthly plans.

How do agency pricing work?

Agencies get custom pricing based on client volume, possible revenue share on referrals, team training, and custom product development for high-volume partners. Contact us to set up an agency account.

What payment methods do you accept?

We accept all major credit and debit cards via Stripe. Annual plans can also be invoiced on request.

What determines the pricing?

Pricing is based on three things: the number of prompts you track, the number of AI engines monitored, and the volume of AI answers analyzed per month. More prompts and more platforms mean more data, which costs more to run at scale.

Can the prompt amount be adjusted?

Yes. You can add more prompts to your plan at any time. If you consistently need more than your current plan allows, upgrading takes effect immediately. You can also contact us for a custom prompt volume outside standard plan tiers.

Can I split prompts across multiple projects?

Yes. Your monthly prompt allowance can be distributed across as many projects as you want. If you're on the Pro plan with 150 prompts, you can run three projects with 50 prompts each, or any other split that fits your setup.
